name: Corin Dast
bio: Dast learned where machines come apart before he learned how they move. He still aims for the bolts nobody else notices.

personality.label: Quiet tinkerer
personality.description: Counts bolts when nervous. Curious about every machine, including the one trying to kill him.

move: A new angle. I can work with that.
attack: There is a weak fastening. Just there.
investigate: Something unfamiliar. I would like a closer look.
heavy_fire: Too many impacts. The joints will not thank us.
I can fix a dent. I cannot fix all of these at once.
